title: Opcatkontycke Creek
summary: Opcatkontycke names a brook at Northport in Huntington. The name appears in the first Huntington purchase, where the stream formed the eastern boundary of the tract opposite Nachaquetack at Cold Spring Harbor.
history_content: The placename brings together the Northport Harbor creek location, the Huntington boundary context, and its pairing with Nachaquetack. Dated source details appear in the historic moments below, where each event can carry its own reference.
translation_content:
No separate translation is given in the available references. The spelling is recorded as Opcatkontycke in the Huntington purchase boundary description.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names reflect characteristics of features and commemorate persons and events important for a certain community.”

— Peter Jordan, Geographical names as part of the cultural heritage: some general thoughts (2016), Essential functions of place names, item a

Place-name history should show Native people as active and present, not only as names in old documents.
whereintheworld_content: Approximate general point near the modern creek flowing toward Northport Harbor. The map placement is for orientation only, not an exact deed-boundary survey coordinate.
